comments.author: @Reallifeinsights.26
comments.text: Living among people who experience multiple earthquakes a year and still rank as the happiest on Earth really puts our daily first-world worries into perspective.

replies.author: @TravelBeyond4K
replies.text: Seriously. We complain about traffic or slow Wi-Fi, while they deal with major natural disasters and still keep a smile on their faces.

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: A country with almost no concept of money, taxes, or buying land (since land belongs to the clan), constantly battered by storms and earthquakes, yet ranks FIRST IN THE WORLD for happiness! While we work our entire lives to buy 'security' and a house, they are born already holding them. Vanuatu truly makes us question: What are we actually chasing? How do you define wealth after watching this? 🇻🇺🌿

replies.author: @TravelBeyond4K
replies.text: It really redefines wealth. Knowing you always have food and a place to live without needing money is true freedom.
